model_solution: نحوّل: \((\cos\theta - i\sin\theta)^4 = (\cos\theta + i\sin\theta)^{-4}\). نجمع الأسس: \(8 + (-4) = 4\). الناتج \((\cos\theta + i\sin\theta)^4 = \cos 4\theta + i\sin 4\theta\).
